title: Pantry taps and use-it-up nudges
lead: Optional correction taps, and "use it up" hints (N2, N3).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** notifications (they reuse these hints later).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Taps improve accuracy at near-zero effort, and nudges turn the estimates into less waste.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None if the pantry interview is done. Confirm the placement on the Today view with a non-technical household member.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. A pantry page listing the estimates with taps.
2. Nudge query plus an optional widget on the Today view.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; a non-technical household member can tap "used it up" from the Today view.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
